description: A heated platen press used to strike engraved blocks onto covers. The block is glued to a movable plate fixed in a heating box, and an adjustable bed lets the finisher land the impression in the same spot across books of differing sizes.
name: arming press

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter XV, p.229. Internet Archive.
